options: Salesforce's public site for live status, security, compliance, and availability information
A private internal tool only Salesforce employees can access
A marketplace for buying third-party Salesforce apps
A certification exam registration portal
questions.explain: trust.salesforce.com is Salesforce's dedicated, public transparency site covering instance status, security, compliance, and availability.

questions.q: Why would an admin check trust.salesforce.com when a user reports 'Salesforce is slow'?
options: To change the user's password
It's the fastest way to rule out a platform-wide issue before troubleshooting the org's own configuration
trust.salesforce.com has no connection to performance issues
To submit a support ticket directly to Salesforce engineering
questions.explain: Checking instance status on trust.salesforce.com is a common first troubleshooting step, ruling out a platform-side issue before assuming the problem is in the org's own setup.

questions.q: What do profiles and permission sets primarily control?
options: Which specific records a user can see
A user's password strength requirements
Access to functionality — which objects, fields, and apps a user can use
The org's instance assignment
questions.explain: Profiles (one per user) and permission sets (stackable add-ons) control functional access — what a user can use, not which individual records they can see.

questions.q: What do sharing rules and org-wide defaults primarily control?
options: Which specific records a user can see, separate from their functional access
Which Salesforce edition the org is on
The order releases are rolled out in
Whether Multi-Factor Authentication is required
questions.explain: Sharing rules and org-wide defaults control record-level visibility — which specific rows a user can see — distinct from the functional access granted by profiles and permission sets.

questions.q: What does Salesforce require of every user for authentication, platform-wide?
options: A unique IP address for every login
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) in addition to username and password
A new password every single day
Biometric login only, with no password option
questions.explain: Salesforce enforces Multi-Factor Authentication for every user platform-wide, requiring a second proof of identity beyond just username and password.
